metas.name: American Samoa Manu’a and Olosega - silver-grey truck
metas.note: The front of a silver-grey truck with side mirrors can be seen on Manu’a and Olosega, which are connected by a bridge.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: American Samoa Rusty  - rusted black truck
metas.note:
A slightly rusted black truck bed can be seen on the main island of Tutuila.

This is the most common car that will be seen as it has the most coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: American Samoa Tau - black car
metas.note: The front of a similar truck can be seen on the easternmost covered island of Tau. However, the truck will be glossy black, with side mirrors visible.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Bermuda - black car
metas.note: Bermuda features a black Street View car with the entire front sides of the vehicle typically visible.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Bohol - tape
metas.note: In northwestern Bohol you can find this Street View car with tape on the back.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Christmas island - silver pickup truck
metas.note:
Christmas Island has two types of coverage: car coverage and a couple of trekkers.

The car coverage was done with a unique Google car: a silver pickup truck, with the bed of the truck visible. Usually, this is all you need to identify Christmas Island.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/christmas-island.

metas.name: Cocos Island Bantam - white car with the rear edges
metas.note:
This white car with the rear edges visible is found in Bantam.

NOTE: The car may be fully blurred. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Cocos Island west - snorkel at the front right and the edges of the bed
metas.note: This unique car with a snorkel at the front right and the edges of the bed visible is found on West Island.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Corregidor - orange car
metas.note: An orange Street View car with visible side mirrors can be found on Corregidor Island.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Curacao - black car, roofrack, white stickers
metas.note: This black car with a roof rack is unique to Curaçao.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/curacao.

metas.name: Dominican Republic - roofrack black + thick black stripes
metas.note:
This unique car was used for all street view coverage in the Dominican Republic. It can be recognized by the two metal bars, the thick black stripes on them, as well as the white hood visible at the front.

NOTE: These stripes can also be found on one of the Mongolian cars, but the landscape should allow you to tell them apart.

Within the Americas, you will also see metal bars in Guatemala and Curaçao. However, they will not have thick black stripes.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/dominican-republic.

metas.name: General Santos - google car
metas.note: You may find this black Street View car with a visible roof rack in and around the city of General Santos.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Guam - antenna + roof rack
metas.note:
The entire Google car is blurred, however an antenna at the front right and a tiny part of the roof rack can be seen.

NOTE: You will not see a roof rack on the Northern Mariana Islands Google car.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/guam.

metas.name: Northern Mariana Islands - close antenna
metas.note: The entire Google car is blurred, however an antenna at the front right can be seen. The antenna is also noticeably closer to the camera than in the Guam Google car.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/northern-mariana-islands.

metas.name: Puerto Rico gen 3 -  antenna
metas.note:
The Google Car found in Puerto Rico has an antenna at the front right. The antenna has a small white dot on the tip.

NOTE: The Google car on Guam and NMI also have an antenna at the front right. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Puerto Rico gen 4 - Smallcam
metas.note: Puerto Rico uses Smallcam, a variant of Generation 4, which in this case can be recognised by the wide blur and antenna that is often visible. The camera is lower and the front blur more round than pickup truck blurs.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Reunion - roofrack + tape
metas.note:
Réunion has a Street View car with visible side mirrors, a roof rack, and black tape at the end of the rear right bar.

NOTE: Make sure not to get this confused with the Ghana car, which has tape on the front right bar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Sir Baniyas - visible side mirrors
metas.note: This rare white Google car with visible side mirrors and sparse vegetation is found on Sir Baniyas Island.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Us Virgin Islands North - white car + antenna
metas.note: A white car with an antenna can only be seen in the northern islands of St Thomas and St John. The cab is also noticeably shorter than the other two cars.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: US Virgin islands red car - southern red car
metas.note: This red truck with a red cab can only be seen in the southern island of St Croix. This is the most common car that will be seen as St Croix has the most coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: US Virgin islands southern white car - white car no antenna
metas.note: A white car without an antenna can also be seen on St Croix, however it will be less common than the red car.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.
